body.name: PT and SC observed-data ATT functionals
body.construction: \(\theta_{\mathrm{PT}}(P_O)=\pi_1^{-1}\sum_{x\in\mathcal X}p_X(x)p_1(x)\{\mu_{1,T}(x)-\mu_{1,T-1}(x)-J^{-1}\mathbf 1_J^{\prime}D(x)\}\) and \(\theta_{\mathrm{SC}}(P_O)=\pi_1^{-1}\sum_{x\in\mathcal X}p_X(x)p_1(x)\{\mu_{1,T}(x)-\sum_{g=2}^{J+1}w_g(x)\mu_{g,T}(x)\}\). On \(\mathcal M_{\mathrm{PT}}\), all donor changes equal \(\delta_1^0(x)\), so the first functional identifies \(\theta(P)\); on \(\mathcal M_{\mathrm{SC}}\), the second does so.
